# Extract the month from the date column
df['month'] = df['date'].str.extract(r'^(\w+)', expand=False)

# Filter for games in May
may_games = df[df['month'].str.lower() == 'may']

# Sort by date to ensure chronological order
may_games = may_games.sort_values('date')

# Get the last three games in May
last_three = may_games.tail(3)

# Determine if each game was a loss for the Blue Jays
# Use the loss column to determine losses
last_three['is_loss'] = last_three['loss'].str.contains(r'\(\d+ - \d+\)', regex=True)
num_losses = last_three['is_loss'].count()

# Check if the number of losses is exactly two
answer = (num_losses == 2)
